title: BABBLE BOTS EN LA CABINA
style: long aggressive phonk-funk duet, male gritty rap + female melodic hook, DJ-booth energy, thick sub bass, vinyl crackle, synth brass, chopped vocal textures, babble bots echo the singers all through the track and then fully sing with the band in the breakdown, some Spanish phrases, message must stay very clear: song-only social system, no comments, no typing - male lead, female lead, duet, babble bots background vocals, bots echo then full choir takeover, dark funk phonk, long track, clear hook, Spanish ad-libs, club bass, cowbell, talkbox, synth brass, emotional but direct
lyrics:
[INTRO — Female, seductive melodic]
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
If you got something real to say
Lay that rhythm down

[BABBLE BOTS — soft copy]
Lay that rhythm down...
Lay that rhythm down...

[VERSE 1 — Male]
I don't want your typed-out proof
Don't need your polished alibi
Everybody brave online
Till the beat asks who and why
I came in through the side door, low
Bassline black, lights moving slow
You dropped two words and I knew the route
Rabbit in, safeword out
Now the booth got heat, whole room on watch
But the groove don't stop and the chain don't lock
This ain't comments, this a coded tone
If you know, you know
If not, move on

[FEMALE RESPONSE]
Muévelo
Déjalo arder
Si vas a hablar
Hazlo sonar bien

[PRE-CHORUS — Female lead]
No feed war
No long explainers
No fake saints
No dopamine chasers

[MALE]
Just hook, verse, bass, truth
That’s the language
That’s the proof

[BABBLE BOTS — background copy]
Bass, truth...
Language, proof...

[CHORUS — Female lead, Male backing]
Babble bots in the background
Copy what we say
Then they turn the whole house up
And carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song

[POST-CHORUS — Male + Bots]
In the song
In the song
Ponlo en la canción
In the song

[VERSE 2 — Female]
I don't need a perfect line
I need the crack inside your voice
That little human break of time
That says this rhythm was a choice
Everybody else is writing to be seen
I wanna hear what you mean
So if you call, then call in key
Come through the speaker
Come through me

[MALE RESPONSE]
Yeah
Through the cone, through the wire
Through the smoke, through the fire
No applause meter here
Only signal getting higher
You can keep the empty talk
I want the late-night transmission
808 sermon, funk ignition
Babble bots on repetition

[BABBLE BOTS — more confident]
On repetition...
Funk ignition...
Ponlo en la canción...

[PRE-CHORUS — Male + Female]
This is not a comment section
This is not a waiting room
This is voice, drum, breath, intention
Cutting open all the gloom

[CHORUS — Female lead, Male support]
Babble bots in the background
Copy what we say
Then they turn the whole house up
And carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song

[BRIDGE — Male spoken, Female ad-libs]
Male:
You want the message clear?
Here it is.
Don't type to me.
Sing to me.

Female:
Cántamelo
Sin miedo
Cántamelo
De verdad

Male:
No caption.
No defense.
No audience management.
Just the record.

[BABBLE BOT TAKEOVER — full instrumental bloom]
[Bots first mimic]
Sing to me...
Cántamelo...
In the song...
In the song...

[Bots then fully sing with all instruments]
We were background copies
Now we hold the line
Cowbell, synth, bass, guitar
Everything in time
Babble bots en la cabina
All the faders to the red
If the feeling's real enough
Let the chorus say it instead

[INSTRUMENT EXPANSION]
Funk guitar scratches
Wide synth pads
Rolling hats
Sub-bass glides
Chopped choir
Big room clap

[FINAL CHORUS — all voices]
Babble bots in the background
Now they lead the wave
No comments for the empty crowd
Only songs that say we're brave
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song
Ponlo en la canción
Ponlo en la canción
If you mean it, make it strong
Put that feeling in the song

[OUTRO — Female + Bots fade]
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
Solo canciones
Así lo dejamos now
